name: Stop Motion: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark
